sources.entry: Bolt.new - AI-powered full-stack web development platform #freemium

summary.name: Bolt.new
summary.one_liner: Bolt is an AI-powered platform for building websites and apps by chatting with an AI agent.
use_cases: Prototyping app ideas with a team
Building landing pages and campaign pages
Launching a small business website or product
Creating full-stack web apps from a text prompt
Learning by turning class or side projects into working apps
summary.what_it_does: Bolt lets users describe websites or apps in plain language and builds them through a chat interface. It automatically routes each task to a model and offers a Standard agent for general development, with a Max option listed as Pro only. The page says Bolt tests, refactors, and iterates on code to reduce errors, and that it handles projects about 1,000 times larger than before. Bolt Cloud is described as providing hosting, databases, and integrations. The page also mentions design system support for on-brand builds.
notable: Chat-based full-stack app and website generation
Automatic model routing between coding agents
Bolt Cloud with built-in hosting, databases and integrations
Design system support for on-brand builds
caveats: Max agent option is available to Pro users only
The page claims a 98% reduction in errors and 1,000x larger project capacity without independent evidence
